sources.label: Morphe patches for mobile phone apps: skip ads, block tracking, and more.
sources.author: Mobile
patch_list: Block analytics & tracking
Blocks the tracking you choose in the patch options.
Disable auto-updates
Stops the Play Store from replacing the patched app with the official version.
Enable developer menu
Opens the hidden developer menu with a long-press on the Fox logo in Settings.
Hide app promotions
Removes the "Download the Fox News app" links from articles.
Hide comments and reactions
Removes the comments section, the floating comments button, and the emoji reactions from articles.
Hide device identifiers
Hides details about your phone from the app. Choose which ones in the patch options.
Hide prediction markets
Removes Kalshi and Polymarket market widgets from articles and live blogs.
Hide rating prompt
Stops Google Play's rate-this-app sheet.
Route traffic through a proxy
Sends the app's network traffic through a proxy you choose, such as Orbot or a VPN service's SOCKS5 server.
Skip ads
Removes the banner, feed, sponsored, and full-screen ads, and the ad breaks in videos.

sources.label: Patches for Android TV streaming apps
sources.author: TV
patch_list: Block analytics & tracking
Stops the app's analytics, ad measurement, and marketing services.
Disable auto-updates
Stops the Play Store from replacing the patched app with the official version.
Force highest quality
Plays the highest quality the stream offers, instead of lowering it to match the measured connection speed. Turn it off if videos buffer.
Hide device identifiers
Hides details about your device from the app. Choose which ones in the patch options.
Opt out of data sale & sharing
Starts the app opted out of the sale and sharing of your data.
Skip ads
Removes the video ads and pause ads in on-demand videos and the targeted ads on live channels.
